title: Human-LLM Alignment in Language Attitudes Toward Non-Native Japanese

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM and human Likert-scale evaluations (measuring fluency, status, and solidarity) of parallel Japanese emails written by native (L1) and non-native (L2) speakers.
Analyzing whether LLM and human ratings of non-native writing vary significantly depending on the writer's first language (L1) background (e.g., English, Chinese, French, Korean, Spanish).
